people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Elisha died, and they buried him. Now the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.
translations.bsb: And Elisha died and was buried. Now the Moabite raiders used to come into the land every spring.
